diagnosis: Possible Renal Colic due to obstructive uropathy or Appendicitis
correct_orders: Laboratory tests: Complete Blood Count (CBC), Chemistry Panel, Urinalysis
should_avoid: Order for immediate surgical intervention without proper diagnostics

rationale.Order for immediate surgical interventio: Avoid premature and invasive procedures without confirming the diagnosis.
rationale.Oxygen: Immediate oxygen administration is crucial for any case involving respiratory distress or AMS.
rationale.IV access x2 large-bore: Large-bore IV access is essential for rapid fluid resuscitation if necessary.

physical_exam: Pain in Side — exam tailored to chief complaint on arrival.
Soft, non-distended, no focal peritoneal signs on initial exam.
Alert and oriented unless perfusion or metabolic derangement present.
No acute rash; capillary refill and perfusion assessed.
